title: Dead air on the new SIP trunk
scenario: Since last week some LFG back-office users on Avaya phones hear nothing on calls through the Chime SDK Voice Connector trunk while the far end hears them; a redial usually works. The dashboard shows no SIP errors and the NOC blames a DTMF payload type mismatch. Work the SIP ladders, Voice Connector SIP and media metric logs, the change record and NAT table to the root cause.
task: Correlate failing calls with SBC, SDP and media metrics; explain why the change test passed
Implement an SDP audit (private c=, SRTP, crypto, telephone-event, missing connection)
Fix the SBC profile with the smallest safe change; prove it with audit and replay
Rule the DTMF payload type ticket in or out with evidence
acceptance: auditSdp findings correct for crafted SDPs and for the incident bundle
Every SBC profile advertises a public media address; replay has zero one-way calls
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md

practices.label: Week 3 Mon - SDP offer/answer, NAT and one-way audio, RFC 4733 DTMF
Week 3 Thu - Voice Connector SIP message and media metric logs
Week 3 Wed - SBC topology hiding and media NAT
